EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I don't follow the trends—{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I prefer
classic style. {{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}And I don't care if
anyone thinks I'm old fashioned!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Cuando se trata de decorar, yo
prefiero el estilo clásico a esas
modas absurdas de ahora.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je suis peut-être un peu vieux jeu,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
mais je préfère tout ce qui est
classique.
Je ne cours pas après les dernières
nouveautés.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Seguire le mode è troppo stancante.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Preferisco vestirmi sempre in modo
classico {{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}e ignorare quei villani
che mi dicono che sono superata!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Die neuesten Trends sind nichts für
mich.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ich bevorzuge den kultivierten,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}gepflegten Stil!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ben modanın peşinden koşmam—{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}klasik
stili tercih ederim. {{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Hem eski kafalı
diyen olursa da umurumda değil!

EN:
Sure, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I buy a lot of things here. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}But
I'm not a hoarder. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I just store a lot.
ES:
¡No te creas que me paso el día
comprando!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es que me gusta
venir a curiosear.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est vrai, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}j'ai tendance à acheter
beaucoup de choses... {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Des achats
compulsifs, le plus souvent.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Et je ne jette rien...
IT:
È vero, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}compro un sacco di cose
qui. {{TAG:0003:002B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Poi torno a casa e sistemo
tutto in ordine alfabetico.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ooops, tu non hai sentito
niente,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} vero?!
TRANSLATION:
Tabii, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}buradan çok şey alıyorum. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Ama ben
istifçi değilim. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Sadece... çok şey saklıyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}If the walls are looking a bit bare at
your house, you've come to the
right place. {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si estás buscando decoración para
tu hogar, estás en el sitio adecuado,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu pourrais peut-être en profiter
pour acheter quelque chose pour
décorer tes murs, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Se casa tua ti sembra un po' vuota,
sei nel posto giusto. {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn dir das gewisse Etwas als
Zierde für deine Wand fehlt, bist du
hier genau richtig, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Evinin duvarları biraz boş görünüyorsa
tam doğru yere geldin. {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}If I had all the Bells in the world{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}I'd
probably just buy this store and live
inside it.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Si un jour je deviens riche{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}} Je crois
que j'achèterai ce magasin et que
je m'installerai dedans !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Se avessi un fantastilione
di stelline.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}} comprerei questo
negozio e ci verrei a vivere.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hätte ich mehr Sternis als Verstand,
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}würde ich mir diesen Laden kaufen
und einfach darin wohnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Dünyadaki bütün Bell'ler benim olsaydı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}
herhalde bu dükkânı satın alıp içinde yaşardım.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}El otro día, un crío me llamó
"señora".{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Me ofendí un poco, ¡pero
al menos no me llamó "abuela"!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}L'autre jour, un enfant m'a appelée
« maman »...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Au moins,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} il ne m'a pas
appelée « mamie »,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} c'est déjà ça...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}L'altro giorno un cucciolotto mi
ha scambiata per la sua mamma.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ci sono rimasta un po' male,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
ma poi ho pensato {{TAG:0003:0002:}}che almeno non
mi aveva scambiata per la nonna!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Gestern nannte mich ein Kind in
diesem Laden „Mami“.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Wenigstens
hat es nicht „Omi“ gesagt{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Geçen gün küçük bir çocuk bana “anne”
dedi.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Şaşırdım, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ama neyse,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} en azından
“büyükanne” demedi!
